name: CORGI (PALEMOON)
description:
The Corgi is a hardy working Dog from High Rock that is renowned for its intelligence and natural herding ability. There are two breeds of Corgi: the Dawngold Corgi and the Palemoon Corgi.

Known for its fierce loyalty and friendly demeanor, the Palemoon Corgi is favored by farmers throughout High Rock. Their stocky build and short stature make them perfect for driving livestock through the province's rocky lowlands.
